change_policy.patch: implementation correction before economic validation with a new full registry hash
change_policy.minor: documentation or visualization that cannot alter eligibility
change_policy.major: any playbook mechanism, ordered step, entry, invalidation, draw, target, or deadline change

single_changed_concept_family: LSR reversal Context Thesis, independent entry-zone Episodes, and execution-owner-only target completion

playbooks.thesis: A confirmed 4H directional structure with a visible same-direction external draw is followed by a qualified 5m displacement-created FVG or OB, the first return to that frozen zone, and an exact 1m rejection, held reacceptance, or aligned micro BOS. An accepted 1H continuation BOS is supporting evidence, not a mandatory causal gate.

required_sequence.description: A confirmed 4H HH/HL or LH/LL structure and a visible 4H draw support the same direction.
A later qualified 5m displacement leaves an exact typed FVG or OB and Group5 registers its frozen entry location.
The first completed 1m return is bound to that exact frozen FVG or OB after departure.
The same zone-return path records wick rejection, held reacceptance, or an aligned strictly-later micro BOS without a terminal contradiction.

phase_rules.inactive: No typed directional setup is active.
phase_rules.forming: The directional structure, external draw, or continuation mechanism is still forming.
phase_rules.armed: The H4 structure and external draw exist while a qualified displacement zone is still forming; H1 continuation acceptance may strengthen but is not required.
phase_rules.waiting_location: The exact 5m FVG or OB is frozen and has not yet received its first completed 1m return.
phase_rules.waiting_trigger: The first pullback is registered and the exact 1m trigger is still absent.
phase_rules.executable: All ordered market gates, frozen plan, draw and remaining-path gates are true.
phase_rules.entered: The independent risk engine approved and the later-bar order filled.
phase_rules.weakening: A triggered or entered thesis remains identifiable while current delivery, frozen path resolution, or execution permission weakens; it cannot ENTER in this phase. Discovery-root absence alone does not weaken an Entry Episode when its exact frozen setup, location and path remain uniquely live.
phase_rules.delivering: Price progresses toward the frozen primary deliverable target while the 4H external draw remains terminal context.
phase_rules.completed: The frozen primary deliverable target is delivered before invalidation and deadline.
phase_rules.invalidated: The frozen zone failure boundary, draw, deadline, or terminal path contradiction invalidates the setup.

invalidation.source: the exact Group5 entry location failure boundary

context_terminal_authority.rule: a mutable higher-timeframe leg or swing projection may revise supporting evidence but cannot close the Context Thesis, an Entry Episode, or a managed position; only an exact typed terminal of an immutable role may close the Context and cascade its children

targets.source: decision-time visible same-direction structural liquidity inventory
targets.selection: select a visible, unconsumed structural-liquidity item strictly between planned entry and the terminal 4H external draw, before every relevant hard barrier, with planned target R >= 1 and current remaining path R >= 1

thesis_context_terminal_draw.source: decision-time visible same-direction H4-timeframe draw; higher-timeframe/external relative to the M5 setup without an added structural-rank gate
thesis_context_terminal_draw.role: establish and retain the directional thesis and terminal delivery context

primary_deliverable_target.role: the executable trade target evaluated by delivery calibration
primary_deliverable_target.re_evaluation: allowed before Risk approval while current visible inventory, obstruction and path geometry remain causal

deadline.rule: Entry Episode freezes the typed plan deadline bounded by the session; runtime Context has no entry/session deadline and closes only on frozen structure, context draw, market epoch or data/contract boundary; thesis calibration uses a separate registered session-close observation horizon
deadline.root_absence_lifecycle: Continue the same root-specific Entry Episode only while the current observation uniquely resolves its identical frozen setup, location and active path and no structural, draw, deadline or boundary terminal is present; otherwise retain it as dormant without action authority.

playbooks.thesis: A formed liquidity pool is swept and fails to sustain outside acceptance, then one frozen reverse-direction qualified 5m displacement establishes a reversal Context. Every graph-connected displacement-linked FVG or OB formed after reacceptance is an independent Entry Episode with its own first return, trigger, plan and terminal state. Entry readiness is supplied by an exact rejection, held reacceptance, or aligned micro BOS on that same zone-return path. An accepted OPPOSED 5m MSS and a separately identified mature range are supporting evidence, not duplicate hard gates or alternative entry mechanisms.

required_sequence.description: A Group4 formed-liquidity-pool manipulation is registered at its exact sweep clock.
A later completed 1m bar reclaimed the frozen pool boundary and one additional real completed bar held it; accepted outside is disqualifying and the sweep bar cannot self-confirm reacceptance.

After the sweep failure, freeze the manipulation root, reverse-direction qualified 5m displacement identity, its active/observed clocks and direction as one Context. Every later graph-connected displacement-linked FVG or OB is an independently tracked Entry Episode. An accepted OPPOSED 5m BOS/MSS may strengthen the structural reaction but is not a duplicate mandatory gate or separate entry path.
Each eligible reverse-displacement zone independently waits for its own first completed 1m return; one zone cannot supply another zone's pullback.

The same Entry Episode's exact zone-return path records wick rejection, held reacceptance, or an aligned strictly-later micro BOS after that zone's first return and without a terminal contradiction. The first uniquely timed executable and plan-valid child freezes the Context execution owner; same-clock ambiguity fails closed.

phase_rules.inactive: No formed-pool sweep context is active.
phase_rules.forming: The pool is swept but outside acceptance has not yet failed.
phase_rules.armed: The sweep failed outside acceptance while reverse displacement is still incomplete.
phase_rules.waiting_location: One eligible reverse-displacement FVG or OB Entry Episode is frozen and independently awaits its first return; all sibling zones remain separately observable.
phase_rules.waiting_trigger: That Entry Episode's first return is registered and no trigger bound to the same zone-return path is present.
phase_rules.executable: The full typed reversal sequence, frozen plan, draw and remaining-path gates are true.
phase_rules.entered: The independent risk engine approved and the later-bar order filled.
phase_rules.weakening: A triggered or entered reversal remains identifiable while current delivery, frozen path resolution, or execution permission weakens; it cannot ENTER in this phase. A sibling that did not win the uniquely earliest executable clock also loses action authority without rewriting the winner. Discovery-root or completed Context-path absence alone does not weaken an Entry Episode when its exact frozen Context provenance, location and path remain uniquely live.
phase_rules.delivering: Price progresses toward the frozen opposing liquidity target.
phase_rules.completed: After an Entry Episode becomes the frozen execution owner with a complete plan, that owner's frozen primary target is delivered before invalidation and deadline. Consumption of a provisional pre-owner route target is nonterminal.
phase_rules.invalidated: A local zone/path failure invalidates only its owning Entry Episode. Before the reversal Context is established, accepted outside fails the outside-acceptance hard gate. After the frozen reverse displacement establishes the Context, only an exact original sweep-extreme breach, exact manipulation/source invalidation, the Context deadline or data/contract boundary closes the Context and all children.

invalidation.source: the exact original Group4 manipulation sweep extreme bound to the selected pool context
invalidation.freeze_at: the reversal Context is established by the frozen reverse displacement; every executable child copies the same exact sweep extreme

targets.selection: Before execution ownership exists, each child independently evaluates the nearest deliverable opposing liquidity; this route target is provisional, and its consumption cannot complete a child that is still waiting for its own first pullback or trigger. When an exact crossed mature-range identity exists, its visible opposing boundary becomes an optional route context and its midpoint/value is retained in that child route.

execution_owner_freeze.clock: the first uniquely timed completed bar on which one Entry Episode simultaneously has its own first pullback, same-zone trigger, every hard gate, and a valid plan

deadline.rule: The reversal Context freezes its registered session deadline independently of child zone-return paths; every Entry Episode freezes its own plan deadline no later than that Context deadline.
deadline.root_absence_lifecycle: A completed or compacted Group5 Context path and a temporarily absent open-thesis root do not erase the frozen reversal Context. Exact frozen manipulation, pool-path and displacement provenance may discover later graph-connected zones only while that same Context remains live and before its deadline. A closed, terminal, expired, or formerly known but no-longer-live Context cannot create a new child; existing children may only settle. Each child continues only while its exact location and path remain uniquely live; missing or ambiguous child identity is retained dormant without action authority, never borrowed from a sibling.
deadline.execution_owner: Before action publication, freeze the uniquely earliest completed-clock child whose own first pullback, zone-bound trigger, hard gates and plan feasibility are valid, including its complete entry/stop/primary-target/deadline/route/trigger plan and first-executable clock. That owner snapshot remains the sole plan and first-trigger source after completed or invalidated terminal resolution; terminal phase, reason and clocks may change, while only current remaining-path, target-visibility, hard-obstruction and append-only trigger-family diagnostics remain live. Later zones, stronger triggers, a later target, or a terminal-bar route re-evaluation cannot replace it. Same-clock multiple winners fail closed until a new manipulation Context.

playbooks.thesis: A mature frozen dealing range suffers a failed auction through one boundary, re-enters the range, creates an opposite-direction 5m displacement zone inside the range, returns to that exact zone for the first time, and confirms an aligned 1m trigger toward the opposite range liquidity.

required_sequence.description: A mature authoritative dealing range must exist.
The exact mature-range boundary is swept; a later completed 1m close becomes the frozen reentry candidate and one additional real completed 1m bar holds inside before outside acceptance.

A later opposite-direction displacement leaves a qualified FVG or OB fully inside the frozen range and on the swept-side half of value; the same displacement must qualify an OPPOSED 5m BOS/MSS before the first pullback.
Price makes its first completed-bar return to that exact frozen FVG or OB; a generic 50 percent pullback is not admissible.
After the first pullback, either a qualified reacceptance hold or an exact aligned micro BOS confirms entry readiness.

phase_rules.inactive: No mature range is available; while status contains parked, execution remains disabled even when diagnostic sequence evidence exists.
phase_rules.armed: Its exact boundary sweep has re-entered the range.
phase_rules.waiting_location: A qualified opposite displacement zone exists inside the frozen range.
phase_rules.waiting_trigger: The first pullback reached that exact zone and awaits an aligned trigger.
phase_rules.executable: All five ordered gates, range-contained planned entry, opposite boundary draw, execution reality and remaining path pass.
phase_rules.entered: A position exists for the exact manipulation episode.
phase_rules.weakening: A triggered or entered range thesis remains identifiable while delivery, graph binding, or execution permission weakens without rewriting the original range or sweep extreme.
phase_rules.delivering: The position advances toward the frozen opposite range liquidity.
phase_rules.completed: The frozen target or explicit completion condition was reached.
phase_rules.invalidated: The sweep extreme, range, zone, draw, sequence, deadline or hard execution condition failed.

invalidation.source: exact original mature-range manipulation sweep extreme

targets.source: the opposite visible boundary of the exact frozen dealing range
targets.selection: range midpoint remains a visible value waypoint; the executable target is the exact opposite range-boundary liquidity inventory item

deadline.rule: registered session deadline frozen for the manipulation episode
